topic: Will we be able to predict catastrophic weather events more accurately?
scientific_reframe: How much can an event-aware, physics-informed forecasting and early-warning system improve probabilistic skill, calibration, warning lead time, and false-alarm control for tropical cyclones, tsunamis, and earthquakes, given that the hazards have different physical predictability limits?
human_review_items: Confirm publisher landing pages and local institutional data-access terms before external submission.
Obtain qualified emergency-management and hazard-domain review before any shadow pilot is connected to operational decisions.
